from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import defaultdict, deque


def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            seen.add((r, c))
            todo = [(r, c)]
            cells = []
            while todo:
                x, y = todo.pop()
                cells.append((x, y))
                for nx, ny in ((x - 1, y), (x + 1, y), (x, y - 1), (x, y + 1)):
                    if (0 <= nx < rows and 0 <= ny < cols and
                            (nx, ny) not in seen and grid[nx][ny] == color):
                        seen.add((nx, ny))
                        todo.append((nx, ny))
            r0 = min(x for x, _ in cells)
            c0 = min(y for _, y in cells)
            shape = frozenset((x - r0, y - c0) for x, y in cells)
            components.append((color, cells, shape))

    color_for_shape = {}
    for color, _, shape in components:
        if color != 1:
            color_for_shape[shape] = color

    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, cells, shape in components:
        if color == 1 and shape in color_for_shape:
            replacement = color_for_shape[shape]
            for r, c in cells:
                result[r][c] = replacement
    return result
'''
